asks: Place each surface, whole, in the subgroup of its meaning. The file gives, for each surface, its base and what the WordNet tables say of it (its network group and its pairs with the other surfaces of the collection) and a seed grouping; no verse is read at this step. Start from the seed (surfaces of one word family stay together unless their forms differ in meaning) and amend it by meaning. A surface that WordNet does not hold (a phrase, or a surface with no pair) is a subgroup on its own and still goes through the subgroup analysis. Name each subgroup for the kind of meaning its surfaces share and define it in a sentence. Membership of the collection is settled: set a surface aside only where it is plainly not a member in meaning, with the reason, and the change procedure moves it out. A surface is never split by Strong's code. Mark a placement that is open as uncertain and say what is unsettled. Nothing here judges what a word does for the inner being: a concept (a behaviour) comes into play only in stage 4.

groups.name: exertion toward an end
groups.definition: Words for putting effort into reaching or doing something: to strive and to endeavor, in all their forms, which WordNet pairs as synonyms in one network.

groups.name: going after
groups.definition: Words for going after someone or something, following hard upon it to reach or take it: to pursue, in its two forms.

groups.name: contention
groups.definition: A word for a state of conflict between parties, a quarrel or contest held between them: strife, the noun.

groups.name: joint striving
groups.definition: A phrase for effort or contest carried on together with others, the striving shared by more than one party: strive together.

Pursue and pursued are one word family; WordNet places them in the main network but pairs them with no other surface of the collection. Their kind of meaning differs from strive: going after a person or thing to reach or take it, a movement toward a target, not the spending of effort as such; so a subgroup of their own (GP-04 difference in kind stated).
